verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is on the broadcasts send endpoint, which accepts a future send time in natural language or ISO 8601 (resend-docs-13). Nothing shows scheduling on the transactional send-email endpoint, and nothing documents cancelling a scheduled send. Missing for 10: scheduled_at on the single/transactional send-email API, a cancel/update scheduled email endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
